name: Refined Average Daily Attendance (ADA)
formula: Foundational headcount - everything else keys off this
notes: No multiplier of its own.

name: PEIMS Enrollment
formula: Headcount, distinct from ADA - drives Basic Costs & Retention size thresholds
notes: Membership-based - does NOT drop with chronic absenteeism the way ADA does.

name: Weighted ADA
formula: WADA = (Sum of all Subchapter B & C allotments) / BA_adj
notes: Sole driver of Tier Two Guaranteed Yield. Blends ADA-, Enrollment-, and FTE-based allotments into one aggregate.

name: Special Education FTEs (aggregate)
notes: Subtracted from ADA_ref to derive ADA_reg.

name: Career & Technology FTEs (aggregate)
formula: Equals sum of FTE_cte1 + FTE_cte2 + FTE_cte3 below
notes: Subtracted from ADA_ref to derive ADA_reg. CORRECTED: this is FTE-based, not ADA-based - the source sheet itself labels this line 'Career & Technology FTEs'.

name: ASF ADA
formula: Prior-year ADA, multiplied by rate_asf below
notes: A DIFFERENT figure than ADA_ref (different YEAR) - do not substitute.

name: Prior Tax Year State Certified Property Value
Current Tax Year State Certified Property Value
value_rate: LPE growth factor: x1.056; DPE = actual certified value
notes: 1.056 factor is a statewide LPE growth assumption only.

name: Current Year M&O Tax Rate
value_rate: N/A - district input (statewide avg 0.7143 for reference)

name: Tier One M&O Tax Rate (TR)
value_rate: N/A - district input (statewide avg 0.613 for reference)
formula: Used in Basic Allotment formula and DTR1/DTR2

name: Maximum Compressed Tax Rate
formula: Denominator in Basic Allotment formula: BA x TR_t1/MCR

name: M&O Tax Collections
value_rate: N/A - district input; LPE = prior-year x 1.056

name: Local Share for IFA Lease Purchase
formula: Subtracted from raw local M&O collections
notes: Applies only to districts with an IFA lease-purchase arrangement.

name: Payment to Tax Increment Fund (TIF)
formula: Subtracted from raw local M&O collections
notes: Applies only to districts participating in a TIF/TIRZ.

name: Taxes Refunded under Sec. 26.1115(c)
formula: Added back to raw local M&O collections

name: Yield per Penny
notes: Splits collections into Level 1 (golden) vs Level 2 (copper) pennies.

name: District Basic Allotment - statutory base
source_sheet: Tier One Detail / Summary of Finances

name: Basic Allotment, adjusted for statewide avg SpEd/CTE weight
formula: Used ONLY for Regular Program and Small/Mid-Size lines
notes: Using raw BA here understates those two lines.

name: District Allotment per ADA (compression-adjusted)
value_rate: Lesser of BA or BA x (TR_t1 / MCR)
formula: Compression check on Regular Program allotment
notes: If TR_t1 < MCR the allotment scales down proportionally.

name: Small and Mid-Sized District Adjustment
value_rate: Small (ADA<1,600): ((1,600-ADA)x0.0004)xBA. Mid (ADA<5,000): ((5,000-ADA)x0.000025)xBA. Greater of the two.
formula: Per-ADA add-on shrinking to 0 as ADA rises toward threshold
notes: This IS the district-size vs. marginal-revenue lever you're modeling.

name: State Schools FTE weight
notes: Narrow eligibility - students placed at state schools.

name: Residential Care and Treatment FTE weight
Non-Public Contracts ADA weight
notes: Excluded from the 'Total FTE' subtotal on source sheet - this specific line is genuinely ADA-based, not FTE, per the source sheet's own labeling.

name: Mainstream ADA weight
notes: Highest-population, lowest-weight SpEd category - genuinely ADA-based per the source sheet. Highly relevant to your teacher-mix tinkering module.

name: Early Childhood Intervention (ECI) Set-Aside
formula: Fixed negative adjustment subtracted from total SpEd allotment
notes: Treat as a top-level deduction unless a per-district methodology is found.

name: Dyslexia weight - Non-Special-Ed (PIC 37)
notes: CONFIRMED enrollment-based, not ADA-based - TEA has explicitly stated dyslexia is one of the enrollment-based (not attendance-based) FSP allotments.

name: Dyslexia weight - Special-Ed (PIC 43)
notes: CONFIRMED enrollment-based, same as PIC 37 above.

name: SCE weight (Ed-Disadvantaged concentration)
formula: ENR_sce x w_sce x BA_adj; w_sce scales with concentration %
notes: CORRECTED: TEA has explicitly confirmed State Compensatory Education is enrollment-based, not ADA-based - a chronically-absent-but-enrolled student still generates this allotment.

name: Pregnancy-Related student weight
notes: CORRECTED to enrollment-based, consistent with SCE above.

name: Non-ed-disadvantaged residential treatment weight
notes: CORRECTED to enrollment-based. Narrow eligibility carve-out.

name: Emergent Bilingual weight (base)
notes: Confirmed ADA-based per TEC 48.105 statutory language ('average daily attendance').

name: Non-Emergent Bilingual Dual Language Two-Way weight
notes: Native-English speakers in two-way immersion.

name: CTE weight - not in approved program
notes: CORRECTED: CTE is FTE-based, not ADA-based - Summary of Finances line 4 itself is labeled 'Career & Technology FTEs'.

name: CTE weight - approved program, levels 1-2
notes: CORRECTED to FTE-based. Intro/intermediate course sequence.

name: CTE weight - approved program, levels 3-4
notes: CORRECTED to FTE-based. Capstone/advanced/work-based learning.

name: K-3 Ed-Disadv + Emergent Bilingual weight (pre pre-K)
notes: This is (A) in the sheet's lettered sub-calculation.

name: Full-day Pre-K allotment (carve-out)
value_rate: No separate weight - equals BA_adj x ADA_prek
formula: Funded first, carved OUT of the K-3 pool above (zero-sum, not additive)
notes: Budget-split logic, not a simple additive allotment. Half-day Pre-K ADA is itself counted at one-half the calculated ADA per TEC 29.153(c) - a second layer of ADA-specific mechanics.

name: K-3 All Students weight
notes: Universal K-3 add-on.

name: G/T enrollment cap %
formula: Ceiling on eligible ADA_gt before weight applied
notes: Despite the common name 'enrollment cap,' this ceiling is defined against ADA, not PEIMS Enrollment - worth double-checking against current TAC rule text if precision matters for your app.

name: G/T statewide spending cap
formula: Districts prorated down if statewide total exceeds cap
notes: Binding this run ($100,000,017 vs uncapped $100,310,274).

name: CCMR bonus - Ed-Disadvantaged Graduates
notes: Not ADA/Enrollment/FTE at all - keyed to that year's actual graduating cohort.

name: Fast Growth eligible ADA weight
variable_type: District Input - computable at base tier
formula: ADA_fastgrowth (user enters this district's fast-growth-eligible ADA) x 0.04 x BA_adj
notes: PROGRAMMED at the base weight. Higher growth-percentile tiers (>=60th percentile, per 19 TAC 61.1009) carry higher weights that remain unpublished - if a district qualifies for a higher tier, this will understate its allotment until those tier weights are sourced.

name: TIA - Master Teacher base rate
value_rate: $12,000 per Master Teacher (up to $32,000 with high-needs/rural multiplier), SY 2025-26
formula: Count_tia_master (user enters # of Master-designated teachers) x rate_tia_master
notes: PROGRAMMED: rate confirmed via TEC 48.112(c). User supplies the district's actual count of TEA-designated Master teachers. SY26-27 rate rises to $12,000-$36,000 per HB2 - update when that year begins.

name: TIA - Exemplary Teacher base rate
value_rate: $6,000 per Exemplary Teacher (up to $18,000 with high-needs/rural multiplier), SY 2025-26
formula: Count_tia_exemplary (user enters # of Exemplary-designated teachers) x rate_tia_exemplary
notes: PROGRAMMED: rate confirmed via TEC 48.112(c). SY26-27 rate rises to $9,000-$25,000 per HB2 - update when that year begins.

name: TIA - Recognized Teacher base rate
value_rate: $3,000 per Recognized Teacher (up to $9,000 with high-needs/rural multiplier), SY 2025-26
formula: Count_tia_recognized (user enters # of Recognized-designated teachers) x rate_tia_recognized
notes: PROGRAMMED: rate confirmed via TEC 48.112(c). SY26-27 rate rises to $5,000-$15,000, plus new Acknowledged tier $3,000-$9,000 - update when that year begins.

name: Mentor teacher / mentee pairs rate
value_rate: User-supplied - no statewide per-pair rate has been published as of this writing
variable_type: District Input - structure ready, rate not yet sourced
formula: Count_mentor (user enters # of qualifying mentor/mentee pairs) x rate_mentor (user enters known $ amount, if any)
notes: PROGRAMMED STRUCTURALLY, but unlike TIA and Fast Growth, no real dollar rate could be located in TEC or TEA correspondence. Both the count AND the rate are left as open user inputs rather than seeding a fabricated default - update rate_mentor the moment a real figure surfaces.

name: School Safety Allotment - per ADA
notes: Increased under HB 2 (2025) from the prior $10/ADA base.

name: School Safety Allotment - per campus
notes: KEY STEP-COST VARIABLE - lumpy relative to ADA, jumps with campus count, not enrollment.

name: Regular transportation rate
notes: Needs each district's route mileage - not an ADA/enrollment-driven figure at all.

name: Special Education transportation rate
notes: Verify current rate before hardcoding - subject to appropriation.

name: New Instructional Facility Allotment (NIFA)
value_rate: Formula-based on facility sq ft/enrollment - no flat statewide rate
formula: Per-district facility-specific formula, triggered only when a new facility opens
notes: KEY ONE-TIME EVENT VARIABLE for your district-size/step-cost modeling. Do not confuse with I&S's IFA.

name: R-PEP Ed-Disadvantaged ADA weight
notes: Small/rural district CTE partnership incentive.

name: Full Individual and Initial Evaluation (FIIE) rate
notes: New under HB 2 (2025). Denominator is completed EVALUATIONS, not students enrolled/attending.

name: District enrollment size threshold
formula: Gate that selects which rate bucket below applies
notes: KEY STEP-COST VARIABLE for your district-size modeling. Confirmed enrollment-based, not ADA.

name: Teacher Retention - small district, 3-4 yrs exp.
notes: Applies only when ENR_peims <= threshold_district_size.

name: Teacher Retention - small district, 5+ yrs exp.
notes: Applies only when ENR_peims <= threshold_district_size.

name: Teacher Retention - large district, 3-4 yrs exp.
notes: Applies only when ENR_peims > threshold_district_size. Roughly half the small-district rate.

name: Teacher Retention - large district, 5+ yrs exp.
notes: Applies only when ENR_peims > threshold_district_size. Roughly half the small-district rate.

name: Full-Time Virtual and Non-Resident ADA
formula: Subtracted from ADA_reg before this allotment is calculated
notes: A carve-out unique to this allotment.

name: Allotment for Basic Costs rate
formula: ENR_peims x rate_basiccosts (keyed to Enrollment, NOT ADA)
notes: The only Tier One line keyed to Enrollment rather than ADA - confirmed correct as originally labeled.

name: Level 1 Guaranteed Yield rate
notes: Do not assume static across years.

name: Level 2 (Copper Penny) District Tax Rate
value_rate: N/A - derived; uncapped remainder above compressed rate + golden pennies

name: Local Share (Level 1 and Level 2)
notes: Subtracted from the Guaranteed Yield Entitlement.

name: Available School Fund (ASF) per-capita rate
notes: Real state revenue the district keeps - set annually.

name: Instructional Materials Allotment per-student rate
notes: Confirmed via TEA's July 2025 TAA correspondence. Not itemized per-district in SOF.

name: Instructional Materials Allotment - Emergent Bilingual add-on
value_rate: $14.87 per Emergent Bilingual enrolled student (2026-27 biennium)
formula: ENR_eb x rate_imta_eb, stacks on top of rate_imta
notes: Confirmed via the same TEA correspondence.

name: Regional Day School Program for the Deaf (RDSPD) rate
value_rate: $6,925.00 per student minimum, topped up pro-rata to meet a $35,000,000 statewide floor
formula: Count_rdspd x rate_rdspd (minimum guarantee, prorated up if statewide total falls short)
source_sheet: Funding for Regional Day School Program for the Deaf
